description: Issue #286: entry settlement requires the ordinary local query and its runtime error.
grammar:
%rule text r :: D | e "a" :: C
%rule e ε
%conditions $.followed-by(r)
%rule r "a" :: A | text<C> boom :: B
%rule boom ε
%conditions "x" ∈ "x".split($.value)
%check probe #·r
%conditions $.local-readings
%warning "local reading"
